title: Equal Koszul roofs give equal normalized conormal values
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, r a natural number and f,g:Fin r -> A Koszul-regular sequences generating I [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence, def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex]. Let phi and psi be determinant-normalized comparisons from the signed duals to the normal determinant in degree r [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison]. Let epsilon_f and epsilon_g be quasi-isomorphic Koszul augmentations with the quotient formula in degree zero. Let z_f:K(f)->A[-r] and z_g:K(g)->A[-r] be cochain maps. If the roofs epsilon_f^{-1} z_f and epsilon_g^{-1} z_g, followed by the standard single-complex shift isomorphism, are equal in D(A), then the values of phi on the transported top component of z_f and of psi on the transported top component of z_g agree in the normal determinant. No Ext equivalence or existence of a determinant isomorphism is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, finite free Koszul resolution computation; generator independence via Lemma 48.15.4 (Tag 0BQY)

proof.text: Choose a coefficient vector for each f_i in span(range g), and assemble them as a linear map t. The generator chain-map theorem supplies U commuting with augmentations and identifies its top component with exteriorPower.map r t.

Cancel the common derived single-shift isomorphism. Precompose with Q(epsilon_f), use U followed by epsilon_g = epsilon_f, functoriality and the quasi-isomorphism inverses to derive Q(z_f)=Q(U followed by z_g). Apply the equal-derived-top-evaluation theorem and the top equation for U.

The conormal map for f is surjective, and conormal(g) composed with t equals conormal(f), detected by cotangentToQuotientSquare_injective. The conormal basis makes the exterior-dual pairing injective. Evaluate the two normalized comparisons on lifts of arbitrary conormal wedges, use exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti and the modulo-I equality, and conclude their values agree.

proof_origin.place: Q2 complete Lean proof: exterior-power generator chain map; cancellation in D(A); direct Homotopy.comm top-component computation; determinant normalization and injective conormal pairing. No HomComplex cocycle quotients or chosen projective resolution.

theorem koszul_roof_comparison_independent
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f g : Fin r → A)
    (hregf : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (hregg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular g)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = I)
    (φ : koszulDualComplex A r f ⟶
      (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat A) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) r).obj
        (koszulNormalDeterminant A I r))
    (ψ : koszulDualComplex A r g ⟶
      (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat A) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) r).obj
        (koszulNormalDeterminant A I r))
    (hφ : IsKoszulConormalComparison A I r f hf φ)
    (hψ : IsKoszulConormalComparison A I r g hg ψ)
    (εf : (koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)))
    (εg : (koszulComplex A r g).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)))
    [QuasiIso εf] [QuasiIso εg]
    (haugf : ∀ x : ⋀[A]^0 (Fin r →₀ A),
      (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).hom
        (εf.f 0 (((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := 0) rfl).inv x)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A) x))
    (haugg : ∀ x : ⋀[A]^0 (Fin r →₀ A),
      (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).hom
        (εg.f 0 (((koszulComplex A r g).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := 0) rfl).inv x)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A) x))
    (zf : (koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) (-(r : ℤ))).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))
    (zg : (koszulComplex A r g).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) (-(r : ℤ))).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))
    (heq : inv (DerivedCategory.Q.map εf) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map zf ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctors (ModuleCat A)).shiftIso
          (r : ℤ) (-(r : ℤ)) 0 (add_neg_cancel (r : ℤ))).inv.app (ModuleCat.of A A) =
      inv (DerivedCategory.Q.map εg) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map zg ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctors (ModuleCat A)).shiftIso
          (r : ℤ) (-(r : ℤ)) 0 (add_neg_cancel (r : ℤ))).inv.app (ModuleCat.of A A)) :
    koszulComparisonValue A I r f φ ((((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso
      ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := r) rfl).inv ≫ zf.f (-(r : ℤ)) ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (-(r : ℤ))
          (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom)) =
      koszulComparisonValue A I r g ψ ((((koszulComplex A r g).extendXIso
      ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := r) rfl).inv ≫ zg.f (-(r : ℤ)) ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (-(r : ℤ))
          (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom))
